title: Compare from both ends
prompt: Return true when text reads the same forwards and backwards. Compare characters exactly: capital letters and spaces count. An empty string is a palindrome.
hints: Which two characters do you compare first, and which two next?
Use a left index from 0 and a right index from the last character. Move both inward.
Return false at the first pair that differs. Return true when the indexes meet.
checkLabels: level reads the same both ways.
The ends match, and the middle does not.
An empty string is a palindrome.
Every pair must match, not only the ends.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Compares only the first and last characters.
Compares the first half with the second half in the same direction.

feedback: Trace the two indexes on a four-letter word. Every pair, not only the outer one, has to be compared.
